title: The Stage 0 limits from healthy arrays of three laboratories
set_out: Set Stage 0's control-probe limits from healthy EPIC v1 arrays of three laboratories with the corrected measurements, then score every blood cell in whole blood and finish the documentation pass.
open_at_turnover: In progress: the Stage 0 control metrics read on 337 healthy arrays on GitHub (to-do step 23).

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: Stage 0 control metrics on 337 healthy arrays (GRP-004)
entries.what: The bisulfite, hybridization and extension controls of 337 healthy whole-blood arrays from three laboratories (GSE318173, GSE315366, GSE184269), read with the corrected Stage 0 on GitHub.
entries.why: A check that refuses a sample has to be set from what healthy samples actually look like, in more than one laboratory.
